summary: cisco.nxos deprecates nxos_hsrp in favor of nxos_hsrp_interfaces and nxos_vrf_interface in favor of nxos_vrf_interfaces.

answer_card.title: nxos_hsrp and nxos_vrf_interface deprecated
answer_card.answer_md:
- `nxos_hsrp` is deprecated in favor of **`nxos_hsrp_interfaces`**.
- `nxos_vrf_interface` is deprecated in favor of **`nxos_vrf_interfaces`**.
